translation: Took place in posad Serock, 5 June 1890, 7 PM. Appeared personally Fiszel[?] Bochenek, shoemaker, 37, and Zyskind[?] Borensztejn, laborer, 29, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that on 4 June of the current year at 8 PM died in posad Serock a child of female sex named Chana Fryszman, aged one year and six months, daughter of Jankiel and Ruchla nee Kozylska[?], the Fryszman spouses residing in posad Serock. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us; the witnesses are illiterate.
